descFull: Prowler is the Open Cloud Security Platform trusted by thousands to automate security and compliance in any cloud environment. With thousands of ready-to-use checks and compliance frameworks, delivers real-time, customizable monitoring and seamless integrations, making cloud security simple, scalable, cost-effective for organizations of any size.
